title: assessment.grade_changed payload
description: Payload of the assessment.grade_changed event (assessment-service; docs/architecture.md §3.1 row 4; docs/testing_model.md §7.1; docs/backlog/closed_questions.md TD-1). Audit/notification-only: it does NOT update the category projection in selection-service. Mirrors an assessment.grade_history row (docs/data_model.md §6.1).

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate (candidate.profiles.id, logical reference).

specialization_code.description: Specialization taxonomy code for the grade change.

direction.description: Direction of the grade change; matches assessment.grade_history.direction (docs/data_model.md §6.1).

category_code.description: Category code after the change; null when not (re)assigned (docs/data_model.md §6.1).

session_id.description: Test session that produced the change; null for a manual/recheck path (docs/data_model.md §6.1).

reason.description: Free-form audit reason; null when not recorded.
